    let pageLoadTime = performance.now();

    const commonTeaParams = {

      region: "US",
      EVENT_ORIGIN_FEATURE: 'TEMAI',

    const sourceParamAllowlist = [
      'channel',
      'register_referrer',
      'utm_source',
      'utm_medium',
      'utm_campaign',
      'utm_term',
      'utm_content',
      'track_code',
      'gclid',
      'qhclickid',
      'ad_platform_id',
      'taskid',
    ];
    const hasOwn = (object, key) =>
      Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(object, key);
    const portalNavigationChannels = new Set([
      'portal_v4',
      'portal_header_v4',
      'global_portal_v4',
    ]);

    const getCurrentSourceParams = () => {
      const currentSearch = new URL(window.location.href).searchParams;
      const sourceParams = {};

      for (const key of sourceParamAllowlist) {
        const value = currentSearch.get(key);
        if (value) {
          sourceParams[key] = value;
        }
      }

      if (!hasOwn(sourceParams, 'channel') && currentSearch.has('register_channel')) {

        if (registerChannel) {
          sourceParams.channel = registerChannel;
        }

        sourceParams.register_referrer = document.referrer;
      }

      return sourceParams;

    const isPortalV4PageUrl = (url) =>
      url.hostname === 'seller.tiktok.com' &&
      (url.searchParams.get('from') === 'portal_v4' ||
        portalNavigationChannels.has(url.searchParams.get('channel')));

    const isSellerAccountUrl = (url) => {
      const isSellerHost =
        url.hostname.startsWith('seller-') &&
        (url.hostname.endsWith('.tiktok.com') ||
          url.hostname.endsWith('.tokopedia.com'));
      const isAccountPath = /^\/account\/(?:login|register)(?:\/|$)/.test(
        url.pathname,
      );

      return isSellerHost && isAccountPath;
    };

    const getTrackedTargetUrl = (target, sourceParams) => {
      const anchor = target?.closest?.('a[href]');
      const href = anchor?.getAttribute('href');

      if (!anchor || !href) return null;

      const targetUrl = new URL(href, window.location.href);
      if (!isPortalV4PageUrl(targetUrl) && !isSellerAccountUrl(targetUrl)) {
        return targetUrl;
      }

      for (const key of sourceParamAllowlist) {
        if (!targetUrl.searchParams.has(key) && hasOwn(sourceParams, key)) {
          targetUrl.searchParams.set(key, sourceParams[key]);

      const sourceParams = getCurrentSourceParams();
      document.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach((anchor) => {
        getTrackedTargetUrl(anchor, sourceParams);

    };

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {

    } else {
      decorateSourceLinks();
    }

    // -----------page_show---------
    const pageSourceParams = getCurrentSourceParams();
    window.Tea('page_show', {
      type: 'page',
      page_type: 'page',
      ...commonTeaParams,
      ...pageSourceParams,
      url: window.location.href,
    })

    // -----------button_click---------
    const trackButtonClick = (moduleName, clickFor, target) => {
      if (!moduleName || !clickFor) return;

      const sourceParams = getCurrentSourceParams();
      const targetUrl = getTrackedTargetUrl(target, sourceParams);

      const params = {
        module_name: moduleName,
        click_for: clickFor,
        ...(target?.dataset.teaEntrance
          ? { entrance: target.dataset.teaEntrance }
          : {}),
        ...commonTeaParams,
        ...sourceParams,
        url: targetUrl?.toString() ?? '',
      };

      if (targetUrl) {
        for (const key of sourceParamAllowlist) {
          if (!targetUrl.searchParams.has(key)) continue;

          const value = targetUrl.searchParams.get(key);
          if (value) {
            params[key] = value;
          } else {
            delete params[key];
          }
        }
      }

      if (target?.tagName?.toLowerCase() === 'a' && window.navigator?.sendBeacon) {
        window.Tea('beaconEvent', 'button_click', params);
        return;
      }

      window.Tea('button_click', params);
    };

    document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      const target = event.target instanceof Element
        ? event.target.closest('[data-tea-module-name][data-tea-click-for]')
        : null;

      if (!target) return;

      trackButtonClick(target.dataset.teaModuleName, target.dataset.teaClickFor, target);
    });

    // Non-click interactions can dispatch mock-click to reuse button_click params.
    document.addEventListener('mock-click', (event) => {
      const detail = event.detail || {};

      trackButtonClick(detail.moduleName, detail.clickFor);
    });

    // -----------module_show---------
    const setupModuleShowTracking = () => {
      if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
        return;
      }
      const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        for (const entry of entries) {
          if (!entry.isIntersecting) {
            continue;
          }
          const moduleName = entry.target.dataset.teaModuleShow;
          if (moduleName) {
            window.Tea('module_show', {
              page_name: 'tts_portal_seller_page_v4',
              region_code: "US",
              module_name: moduleName,
              EVENT_ORIGIN_FEATURE: 'TEMAI',
              extra: 'v4_flag_20260616'
            });
          }
          observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      }, { threshold: 0.1 });
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-tea-module-show]')
        .forEach((element) => observer.observe(element));
    };

      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', setupModuleShowTracking, { once: true });
    } else {
      setupModuleShowTracking();
    }

      if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
        window.Tea('page_duration', {
          duration: performance.now() - pageLoadTime,
          ...commonTeaParams
        });
      } else {
        pageLoadTime = performance.now();
      }
    });

(() => {
	const root = document.querySelector('.success-stories');
	if (!root) return;

	const inputSelector = '.success-stories__input';
	const desktopQuery = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 72.25rem)');
	const tabletQuery = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 47.9375rem) and (max-width: 72.1875rem)');
	const mobileQuery = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 47.875rem)');
	const transitionDuration = 560;
	let layoutSyncFrame = 0;
	let switchingTimer = 0;
	let controlScrollPosition = null;
	let scrollSyncFrame = 0;
	let videoSyncTimer = 0;
	let programmaticScrollTarget = null;
	let programmaticScrollTimer = 0;
	let suppressScrollVideoSyncUntil = 0;
	let swipeStartX = 0;
	let swipeStartY = 0;
	let swipeStartTime = 0;
	let swipeStartOffset = 0;
	let swipeDragFrame = 0;
	let swipeDragX = 0;
	let swipeIsDragging = false;
	let fullscreenStoryId = null;
	let videoProgressFrame = 0;
	let activeStoryVideoId = null;
	const programmaticVideoUntil = new WeakMap();

	const trackStoryButtonClick = (clickFor) => {
		// Swipe and native video controls do not reliably bubble as click events.
		root.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('mock-click', {
			bubbles: true,
			detail: {
				moduleName: 'SuccessStories',
				clickFor,
			},
		}));
	};

	const markProgrammaticVideo = (video) => {
		programmaticVideoUntil.set(video, window.performance.now() + 2000);
	};

	const isProgrammaticVideo = (video) => {
		return (programmaticVideoUntil.get(video) || 0) > window.performance.now();
	};

	const getStoryVideos = () =>
		Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('video[data-success-story-video]')).filter(
			(video) => video instanceof HTMLVideoElement,
		);

	const getRealStoryVideos = () =>
		getStoryVideos().filter((video) => !video.closest('[data-carousel-clone]'));

	const getModal = () => root.querySelector('.success-stories__video-modal');

	const getModalVideo = () => {
		const modalVideo = root.querySelector('video[data-success-story-modal-video]');

		return modalVideo instanceof HTMLVideoElement ? modalVideo : null;
	};

	const getVideoControlsScope = (video) =>
		video?.closest('.success-stories__video-shell') || getModal();

	const syncVideoControls = (video) => {
		if (!(video instanceof HTMLVideoElement)) return;

		const scope = getVideoControlsScope(video);
		if (!(scope instanceof HTMLElement)) return;

		scope.classList.toggle('success-stories__video-shell--playing', !video.paused);
		scope.classList.toggle('success-stories__video-shell--muted', video.muted);

		const playButton = scope.querySelector('[data-success-story-video-action="toggle-play"]');
		if (playButton instanceof HTMLButtonElement) {
			playButton.setAttribute('aria-label', video.paused ? 'Play video' : 'Pause video');
		}

		const muteButton = scope.querySelector('[data-success-story-video-action="toggle-muted"]');
		if (muteButton instanceof HTMLButtonElement) {
			muteButton.setAttribute('aria-label', video.muted ? 'Unmute video' : 'Mute video');
		}

		const progress = scope.querySelector('.success-stories__video-progress');
		const duration = video.duration || 0;
		const progressValue = duration > 0 ? (video.currentTime / duration) * 100 : 0;

		if (progress instanceof HTMLInputElement) {
			if (document.activeElement !== progress) {
				progress.value = String(progressValue);
			}
			progress.style.setProperty('--video-progress', progressValue + '%');
		}
	};

	const pauseAllStoryVideos = ({ mute = false } = {}) => {
		getRealStoryVideos().forEach((video) => {
			markProgrammaticVideo(video);
			video.pause();
			if (mute) {
				video.muted = true;
			}
			syncVideoControls(video);
		});
	};

	const muteStoryVideo = (storyId) => {
		if (!storyId) return;

		getRealStoryVideos().forEach((video) => {
			if (video.dataset.successStoryVideo !== storyId) return;

			markProgrammaticVideo(video);
			video.muted = true;
			syncVideoControls(video);
		});
	};

	const syncAllVideoControls = () => {
		getStoryVideos().forEach(syncVideoControls);
		const modalVideo = getModalVideo();
		if (modalVideo) syncVideoControls(modalVideo);
	};

	const syncPlayingVideoProgress = () => {
		videoProgressFrame = 0;
		getStoryVideos().forEach((video) => {
			if (!video.paused) {
				syncVideoControls(video);
			}
		});

		const modalVideo = getModalVideo();
		if (modalVideo && !modalVideo.paused) {
			syncVideoControls(modalVideo);
		}

		videoProgressFrame = window.requestAnimationFrame(syncPlayingVideoProgress);
	};

	const startVideoProgressSync = () => {
		if (videoProgressFrame) return;

		videoProgressFrame = window.requestAnimationFrame(syncPlayingVideoProgress);
	};

	const syncStoryLayout = () => {
		const panels = root.querySelector('.success-stories__panels');
		const track = root.querySelector('.success-stories__track');
		syncCompactStats();

		if (
			!(panels instanceof HTMLElement) ||
			!(track instanceof HTMLElement)
		) {
			return;
		}

		if (desktopQuery.matches) {
			panels.style.height = '';
			track.style.transform = '';
			return;
		}

		if (!tabletQuery.matches && !mobileQuery.matches) {
			panels.style.height = '';
			track.style.transform = '';
			return;
		}

		const activePanel = getActiveStoryPanel();

		if (!(activePanel instanceof HTMLElement)) {
			return;
		}

		const activePanelHeight = Math.ceil(activePanel.getBoundingClientRect().height);
		panels.style.height = activePanelHeight + 'px';
		track.style.transform =
			'translate3d(-' + activePanel.offsetLeft + 'px, 0, 0)';
	};

	const syncCompactStats = () => {
		const cards = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.success-stories__card'));
		const storyCards = cards.filter((card) => card instanceof HTMLElement);
		let hasLongQuote = false;

		for (const card of storyCards) {
			card.classList.remove('success-stories__card--compact-stats');
			card.classList.remove('success-stories__card--compact-quote');
		}

		if (desktopQuery.matches) {
			hasLongQuote = storyCards.some((card) => {
				const quote = card.querySelector('.success-stories__body > p');

				return (
					quote instanceof HTMLElement &&
					quote.getBoundingClientRect().height > 400
				);
			});
		}

		for (const card of storyCards) {
			if (hasLongQuote) {
				card.classList.add('success-stories__card--compact-quote');
			}

			if (!desktopQuery.matches) continue;

			const values = Array.from(
				card.querySelectorAll('.success-stories__stats > div > span'),
			).filter((value) => value instanceof HTMLElement);

			const hasWrappedMetric = values.some((value) => {
				const styles = window.getComputedStyle(value);
				const lineHeight = Number.parseFloat(styles.lineHeight);
				const singleLineHeight = Number.isFinite(lineHeight)
					? lineHeight
					: Number.parseFloat(styles.fontSize) * 1.15;

				return value.getBoundingClientRect().height > singleLineHeight * 1.35;
			});

			if (hasWrappedMetric) {
				card.classList.add('success-stories__card--compact-stats');
			}
		}
	};

	const scheduleStoryLayoutSync = () => {
		window.cancelAnimationFrame(layoutSyncFrame);
		layoutSyncFrame = window.requestAnimationFrame(syncStoryLayout);
	};

	const getRealStoryPanels = () =>
		Array.from(
			root.querySelectorAll('.success-stories__panel:not([data-carousel-clone])'),
		).filter((panel) => panel instanceof HTMLElement);

	const getActiveStoryPanel = () => {
		const checkedInput = root.querySelector(inputSelector + ':checked');
		const activeId = checkedInput?.id?.replace('success-story-', '');

		return activeId
			? root.querySelector(
					'.success-stories__panel--' + activeId + ':not([data-carousel-clone])',
				)
			: null;
	};

	const setupInfiniteCarouselClones = () => {
		const track = root.querySelector('.success-stories__track');

		if (!(track instanceof HTMLElement)) {
			return;
		}

		if (desktopQuery.matches) {
			track.querySelectorAll('[data-carousel-clone]').forEach((clone) => {
				clone.remove();
			});
			delete track.dataset.carouselCloned;
			return;
		}

		if (track.dataset.carouselCloned === 'true') {
			return;
		}

		const panels = getRealStoryPanels();
		const firstPanel = panels[0];
		const lastPanel = panels[panels.length - 1];

		if (!(firstPanel instanceof HTMLElement) || !(lastPanel instanceof HTMLElement)) {
			return;
		}

		const firstClone = firstPanel.cloneNode(true);
		const lastClone = lastPanel.cloneNode(true);

		[firstClone, lastClone].forEach((clone) => {
			if (!(clone instanceof HTMLElement)) return;

			clone.dataset.carouselClone = 'true';
			clone.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
			clone.querySelectorAll('video').forEach((video) => {
				video.removeAttribute('autoplay');
				video.pause();
			});
		});

		lastClone.dataset.carouselClone = 'start';
		firstClone.dataset.carouselClone = 'end';
		track.prepend(lastClone);
		track.append(firstClone);
		track.dataset.carouselCloned = 'true';
	};

	const markStorySwitching = () => {
		window.clearTimeout(switchingTimer);
		root.classList.add('success-stories--is-switching');
		switchingTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
			root.classList.remove('success-stories--is-switching');
		}, transitionDuration);
	};

	const syncVideos = ({ resetActive = true } = {}) => {
		const checkedInput = root.querySelector(inputSelector + ':checked');
		const activeId = checkedInput?.id?.replace('success-story-', '');
		const videos = getStoryVideos();
		const previousActiveId = activeStoryVideoId;

		if (previousActiveId && previousActiveId !== activeId) {
			muteStoryVideo(previousActiveId);
		}
		activeStoryVideoId = activeId || null;

		videos.forEach((video) => {
			if (!(video instanceof HTMLVideoElement)) return;
			if (video.closest('[data-carousel-clone]')) return;
			markProgrammaticVideo(video);

			const shouldPlay =
				!fullscreenStoryId && video.dataset.successStoryVideo === activeId;

			if (!shouldPlay) {
				if (!video.paused) {
					video.pause();
				}
				syncVideoControls(video);
				return;
			}

			if (resetActive) {
				video.currentTime = 0;
			}

			if (video.paused) {
				void video.play().catch(() => undefined);
			}
			syncVideoControls(video);
		});
	};

	const scheduleVideoSync = ({ resetActive = false, delay = 160 } = {}) => {
		window.clearTimeout(videoSyncTimer);
		videoSyncTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
			syncVideos({ resetActive });
		}, delay);
	};

	const getStoryInputs = () =>
		Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(inputSelector)).filter(
			(input) => input instanceof HTMLInputElement,
		);

	const selectStoryInput = (input) => {
		if (!input || input.checked) return;

		input.checked = true;
		trackStoryButtonClick(input.dataset.teaClickFor);
		input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
	};

	const setCheckedStory = (
		storyId,
		{ resetVideo = false, syncVideo = true, trackSwitch = false } = {},
	) => {
		const input = root.querySelector('#success-story-' + storyId);

		if (!(input instanceof HTMLInputElement) || input.checked) return;

		input.checked = true;
		if (trackSwitch) {
			trackStoryButtonClick(input.dataset.teaClickFor);
		}

		if (syncVideo) {
			syncVideos({ resetActive: resetVideo });
		}
	};

	const syncDesktopActiveStory = () => {
		scrollSyncFrame = 0;

		if (!desktopQuery.matches) return;

		if (programmaticScrollTarget) {
			setCheckedStory(programmaticScrollTarget, { syncVideo: false });
			return;
		}

		const panels = Array.from(
			root.querySelectorAll('.success-stories__panel'),
		).filter((panel) => panel instanceof HTMLElement);

		if (panels.length === 0) return;

		const activationLine = window.innerHeight * 0.42;
		let activePanel = panels[0];
		let activeDistance = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;

		panels.forEach((panel) => {
			const rect = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
			const distance = Math.abs(rect.top - activationLine);

			if (
				rect.top <= window.innerHeight * 0.72 &&
				rect.bottom >= window.innerHeight * 0.2 &&
				distance < activeDistance
			) {
				activePanel = panel;
				activeDistance = distance;
			}
		});

		const storyId = Array.from(activePanel.classList)
			.find((className) => className.startsWith('success-stories__panel--story-'))
			?.replace('success-stories__panel--', '');

		if (storyId) {
			setCheckedStory(storyId, { syncVideo: false, trackSwitch: true });

			if (window.performance.now() >= suppressScrollVideoSyncUntil) {
				scheduleVideoSync({ resetActive: false });
			}
		}
	};

	const scheduleDesktopActiveStorySync = () => {
		if (!desktopQuery.matches || scrollSyncFrame) return;

		scrollSyncFrame = window.requestAnimationFrame(syncDesktopActiveStory);
	};

	const scrollToStory = (storyId) => {
		const panel = root.querySelector(
			'.success-stories__panel--' + storyId + ':not([data-carousel-clone])',
		);

		if (!(panel instanceof HTMLElement)) return;

		window.clearTimeout(programmaticScrollTimer);
		programmaticScrollTarget = storyId;
		setCheckedStory(storyId, { syncVideo: false });
		panel.scrollIntoView({
			behavior: 'smooth',
			block: 'center',
			inline: 'nearest',
		});
		programmaticScrollTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
			suppressScrollVideoSyncUntil = window.performance.now() + 1000;
			programmaticScrollTarget = null;
			syncVideos({ resetActive: false });
		}, 1100);
	};

	const animateInfiniteWrap = (targetInput, clonePanel) => {
		const panels = root.querySelector('.success-stories__panels');
		const track = root.querySelector('.success-stories__track');
		const storyId = targetInput.id.replace('success-story-', '');
		const targetPanel = root.querySelector(
			'.success-stories__panel--' + storyId + ':not([data-carousel-clone])',
		);

		if (
			!(panels instanceof HTMLElement) ||
			!(track instanceof HTMLElement) ||
			!(clonePanel instanceof HTMLElement) ||
			!(targetPanel instanceof HTMLElement)
		) {
			selectStoryInput(targetInput);
			return;
		}

		markStorySwitching();
		panels.style.height =
			Math.ceil(clonePanel.getBoundingClientRect().height) + 'px';
		track.style.transform =
			'translate3d(-' + clonePanel.offsetLeft + 'px, 0, 0)';

		window.clearTimeout(switchingTimer);
		switchingTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
			targetInput.checked = true;
			trackStoryButtonClick(targetInput.dataset.teaClickFor);
			track.style.transition = 'none';
			panels.style.height =
				Math.ceil(targetPanel.getBoundingClientRect().height) + 'px';
			track.style.transform =
				'translate3d(-' + targetPanel.offsetLeft + 'px, 0, 0)';
			void track.offsetHeight;
			track.style.transition = '';
			root.classList.remove('success-stories--is-switching');
			syncVideos({ resetActive: true });
		}, transitionDuration);
	};

	const switchStoryByDirection = (direction) => {
		if (desktopQuery.matches) return;

		const inputs = getStoryInputs();
		const activeIndex = inputs.findIndex((input) => input.checked);

		if (activeIndex === -1) return;

		const targetIndex =
			(activeIndex + direction + inputs.length) % inputs.length;
		const isForwardWrap = direction > 0 && activeIndex === inputs.length - 1;
		const isBackwardWrap = direction < 0 && activeIndex === 0;
		const targetInput = inputs[targetIndex];

		if (isForwardWrap || isBackwardWrap) {
			const cloneSelector = isForwardWrap
				? '[data-carousel-clone="end"]'
				: '[data-carousel-clone="start"]';
			const clonePanel = root.querySelector(cloneSelector);

			animateInfiniteWrap(targetInput, clonePanel);
			return;
		}

		selectStoryInput(targetInput);
	};

	const switchStoryBySwipe = (deltaX) => {
		switchStoryByDirection(deltaX < 0 ? 1 : -1);
	};

	const setupSwipeControls = () => {
		const panels = root.querySelector('.success-stories__panels');
		const track = root.querySelector('.success-stories__track');

		if (!(panels instanceof HTMLElement) || !(track instanceof HTMLElement)) return;

		const applyDragTransform = () => {
			swipeDragFrame = 0;
			track.style.transform =
				'translate3d(' + (-swipeStartOffset + swipeDragX) + 'px, 0, 0)';
		};

		const beginSwipe = (clientX, clientY) => {
			const activePanel = getActiveStoryPanel();

			if (!(activePanel instanceof HTMLElement)) return;

			swipeStartX = clientX;
			swipeStartY = clientY;
			swipeStartTime = Date.now();
			swipeStartOffset = activePanel.offsetLeft;
			swipeDragX = 0;
			swipeIsDragging = false;
			track.style.transition = 'none';
		};

		const moveSwipe = (clientX, clientY) => {
			if (desktopQuery.matches || !swipeStartTime) return;

			const deltaX = clientX - swipeStartX;
			const deltaY = clientY - swipeStartY;

			if (!swipeIsDragging && Math.abs(deltaX) < 8) return;
			if (!swipeIsDragging && Math.abs(deltaX) < Math.abs(deltaY) * 1.15) return;

			swipeIsDragging = true;
			root.classList.add('success-stories--is-switching');
			swipeDragX = deltaX;

			if (!swipeDragFrame) {
				swipeDragFrame = window.requestAnimationFrame(applyDragTransform);
			}
		};

		const endSwipe = (clientX, clientY) => {
			if (desktopQuery.matches || !swipeStartTime) return;

			const deltaX = clientX - swipeStartX;
			const deltaY = clientY - swipeStartY;
			const minDistance = Math.min(80, panels.clientWidth * 0.18);
			swipeStartTime = 0;
			window.cancelAnimationFrame(swipeDragFrame);
			swipeDragFrame = 0;
			track.style.transition = '';

			if (
				Math.abs(deltaX) < minDistance ||
				Math.abs(deltaX) < Math.abs(deltaY) * 1.25
			) {
				markStorySwitching();
				syncStoryLayout();
				return;
			}

			switchStoryBySwipe(deltaX);
		};

		if (window.PointerEvent) {
			panels.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
				if (desktopQuery.matches || !event.isPrimary) return;
				beginSwipe(event.clientX, event.clientY);
			}, { passive: true });

			panels.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => {
				if (!event.isPrimary) return;
				moveSwipe(event.clientX, event.clientY);
			}, { passive: true });

			panels.addEventListener('pointerup', (event) => {
				if (!event.isPrimary) return;
				endSwipe(event.clientX, event.clientY);
			}, { passive: true });

			panels.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => {
				swipeStartTime = 0;
				window.cancelAnimationFrame(swipeDragFrame);
				swipeDragFrame = 0;
				track.style.transition = '';
				root.classList.remove('success-stories--is-switching');
				syncStoryLayout();
			}, { passive: true });

			return;
		}

		panels.addEventListener('touchstart', (event) => {
			if (desktopQuery.matches || event.touches.length !== 1) return;

			const touch = event.touches[0];
			beginSwipe(touch.clientX, touch.clientY);
		}, { passive: true });

		panels.addEventListener('touchmove', (event) => {
			const touch = event.touches[0];
			if (!touch) return;

			moveSwipe(touch.clientX, touch.clientY);
		}, { passive: true });

		panels.addEventListener('touchend', (event) => {
			const touch = event.changedTouches[0];
			if (!touch) return;

			endSwipe(touch.clientX, touch.clientY);
		}, { passive: true });

		panels.addEventListener('touchcancel', () => {
			swipeStartTime = 0;
			window.cancelAnimationFrame(swipeDragFrame);
			swipeDragFrame = 0;
			track.style.transition = '';
			root.classList.remove('success-stories--is-switching');
			syncStoryLayout();
		}, { passive: true });
	};

	const getStoryVideoById = (storyId) =>
		getRealStoryVideos().find((video) => video.dataset.successStoryVideo === storyId);

	const getVideoSource = (video) =>
		video.currentSrc || video.querySelector('source')?.getAttribute('src') || '';

	const openFullscreenPlayer = (video) => {
		if (!(video instanceof HTMLVideoElement)) return;

		const modal = getModal();
		const modalVideo = getModalVideo();
		const source = getVideoSource(video);

		if (!(modal instanceof HTMLElement) || !modalVideo || !source) return;

		fullscreenStoryId = video.dataset.successStoryVideo || null;
		document.body.classList.add('success-stories-video-modal-open');
		pauseAllStoryVideos({ mute: true });

		modalVideo.src = source;
		modalVideo.dataset.successStoryAccount = video.dataset.successStoryAccount || '';
		modalVideo.muted = false;
		try {
			modalVideo.currentTime = video.currentTime || 0;
		} catch {
			// Some mobile browsers reject currentTime before metadata is available.
		}
		modal.hidden = false;
		root.classList.add('success-stories--video-modal-open');
		syncVideoControls(modalVideo);
		void modalVideo.play().catch(() => {
			modalVideo.muted = true;
			syncVideoControls(modalVideo);
			void modalVideo.play().catch(() => undefined);
		});
	};

	const closeFullscreenPlayer = ({ resumeActive = true } = {}) => {
		const modal = getModal();
		const modalVideo = getModalVideo();

		if (!(modal instanceof HTMLElement) || !modalVideo) return;

		const account = modalVideo.dataset.successStoryAccount;
		if (account) {
			trackStoryButtonClick('video_' + account);
		}

		modalVideo.pause();
		modalVideo.removeAttribute('src');
		modalVideo.load();
		modal.hidden = true;
		root.classList.remove('success-stories--video-modal-open');
		fullscreenStoryId = null;
		document.body.classList.remove('success-stories-video-modal-open');
		syncVideoControls(modalVideo);

		if (resumeActive) {
			syncVideos({ resetActive: false });
		}
	};

	const handleVideoControlAction = (target) => {
		const control = target.closest('[data-success-story-video-action]');
		if (!(control instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;
		if (control.closest('[data-carousel-clone]')) return true;

		const action = control.dataset.successStoryVideoAction;
		const storyId = control.dataset.successStoryVideoTarget;
		const modalVideo = getModalVideo();
		const isModalControl = Boolean(control.closest('.success-stories__video-modal'));
		const video = isModalControl ? modalVideo : getStoryVideoById(storyId);

		if (!(video instanceof HTMLVideoElement)) return true;
		if (
			isModalControl &&
			action !== 'close-fullscreen' &&
			video.dataset.successStoryAccount
		) {
			trackStoryButtonClick('video_' + video.dataset.successStoryAccount);
		}

		if (action === 'toggle-play') {
			if (video.paused) {
				void video.play().catch(() => undefined);
			} else {
				video.pause();
			}
			syncVideoControls(video);
			return true;
		}

		if (action === 'toggle-muted') {
			video.muted = !video.muted;
			syncVideoControls(video);
			return true;
		}

		if (action === 'open-fullscreen') {
			openFullscreenPlayer(video);
			return true;
		}

		if (action === 'close-fullscreen') {
			closeFullscreenPlayer();
			return true;
		}

		return true;
	};

	const handleVideoProgressInput = (target) => {
		if (!(target instanceof HTMLInputElement)) return false;
		if (target.dataset.successStoryVideoAction !== 'seek') return false;
		if (target.closest('[data-carousel-clone]')) return true;

		const storyId = target.dataset.successStoryVideoTarget;
		const modalVideo = getModalVideo();
		const isModalControl = Boolean(target.closest('.success-stories__video-modal'));
		const video = isModalControl ? modalVideo : getStoryVideoById(storyId);

		if (!(video instanceof HTMLVideoElement) || !video.duration) return true;
		if (isModalControl && video.dataset.successStoryAccount) {
			trackStoryButtonClick('video_' + video.dataset.successStoryAccount);
		}

		video.currentTime = (Number(target.value) / 100) * video.duration;
		syncVideoControls(video);
		return true;
	};

	const setupCustomVideoControls = () => {
		getStoryVideos().forEach((video) => {
			video.removeAttribute('controls');
			video.addEventListener('play', () => syncVideoControls(video));
			video.addEventListener('pause', () => syncVideoControls(video));
			video.addEventListener('timeupdate', () => syncVideoControls(video));
			video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => syncVideoControls(video));
			video.addEventListener('volumechange', () => syncVideoControls(video));
		});

		const modal = getModal();
		const modalVideo = getModalVideo();

		if (modal instanceof HTMLElement && modalVideo) {
			modalVideo.removeAttribute('controls');
			modalVideo.addEventListener('play', () => syncVideoControls(modalVideo));
			modalVideo.addEventListener('pause', () => syncVideoControls(modalVideo));
			modalVideo.addEventListener('timeupdate', () => syncVideoControls(modalVideo));
			modalVideo.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => syncVideoControls(modalVideo));
			modalVideo.addEventListener('volumechange', () => syncVideoControls(modalVideo));
			modal.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
				if (event.target === modal) {
					closeFullscreenPlayer();
				}
			});
			modal.addEventListener('wheel', (event) => {
				event.preventDefault();
			}, { passive: false });
			modal.addEventListener('touchmove', (event) => {
				event.preventDefault();
			}, { passive: false });
		}

		document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
			if (event.key === 'Escape' && fullscreenStoryId) {
				closeFullscreenPlayer();
			}
		});

		window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => closeFullscreenPlayer({ resumeActive: false }));
		startVideoProgressSync();
		syncAllVideoControls();
	};

	const setupVideoInteractionTracking = () => {
		const videos = getStoryVideos();
		const lastTrackedAt = new WeakMap();
		let activeVideo = null;
		let activePointerId = null;
		let startX = 0;
		let startY = 0;

		const getVideoFromPoint = (clientX, clientY) => {
			return videos.find((video) => {
				const rect = video.getBoundingClientRect();

				return (
					clientX >= rect.left &&
					clientX <= rect.right &&
					clientY >= rect.top &&
					clientY <= rect.bottom
				);
			});
		};

		const trackVideo = (video, { requireUserActivation = false } = {}) => {
			if (!(video instanceof HTMLVideoElement)) return;

			const now = window.performance.now();
			const lastTracked = lastTrackedAt.get(video) || 0;

			if (now - lastTracked < 1000) return;
			if (isProgrammaticVideo(video)) return;
			if (requireUserActivation && !window.navigator.userActivation?.isActive) {
				return;
			}
			if (!video.dataset.successStoryAccount) return;

			lastTrackedAt.set(video, now);
			trackStoryButtonClick('video_' + video.dataset.successStoryAccount);
		};

		const beginVideoPointer = (clientX, clientY, pointerId = null) => {
			const video = getVideoFromPoint(clientX, clientY);

			activeVideo = video || null;
			activePointerId = pointerId;
			startX = clientX;
			startY = clientY;
		};

		const endVideoPointer = (clientX, clientY, pointerId = null) => {
			if (activePointerId !== null && pointerId !== activePointerId) return;
			if (!(activeVideo instanceof HTMLVideoElement)) return;

			const endVideo = getVideoFromPoint(clientX, clientY);
			const movedDistance = Math.hypot(clientX - startX, clientY - startY);
			const video = activeVideo;
			activeVideo = null;
			activePointerId = null;

			if (video === endVideo && movedDistance <= 16) {
				trackVideo(video);
			}
		};

		document.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
			beginVideoPointer(event.clientX, event.clientY, event.pointerId);
		}, true);
		document.addEventListener('pointerup', (event) => {
			endVideoPointer(event.clientX, event.clientY, event.pointerId);
		}, true);
		document.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => {
			activeVideo = null;
			activePointerId = null;
		}, true);
			document.addEventListener('touchstart', (event) => {
				const touch = event.touches?.[0];
				if (!touch) return;

				beginVideoPointer(touch.clientX, touch.clientY, touch.identifier);
			}, true);
			document.addEventListener('touchend', (event) => {
				const touch = event.changedTouches?.[0];
				if (!touch) return;

				endVideoPointer(touch.clientX, touch.clientY, touch.identifier);
			}, true);

			videos.forEach((video) => {
				const trackControlInteraction = () => {
					trackVideo(video, { requireUserActivation: true });
				};
				let isFullscreenVideo = false;

				video.addEventListener('play', trackControlInteraction);
				video.addEventListener('pause', trackControlInteraction);
				video.addEventListener('seeking', trackControlInteraction);
				video.addEventListener('volumechange', trackControlInteraction);
				video.addEventListener('webkitbeginfullscreen', trackControlInteraction);
				video.addEventListener('webkitendfullscreen', trackControlInteraction);

				document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', () => {
					if (document.fullscreenElement === video) {
						isFullscreenVideo = true;
						trackControlInteraction();
						return;
					}

					if (isFullscreenVideo) {
						isFullscreenVideo = false;
						trackControlInteraction();
					}
				});
			});
		};

	root.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
		if (event.target instanceof Element) {
			if (handleVideoControlAction(event.target)) {
				event.preventDefault();
				event.stopPropagation();
				return;
			}

			const tab = event.target.closest('.success-stories__tab');

			if (desktopQuery.matches && tab instanceof HTMLLabelElement) {
				event.preventDefault();
				scrollToStory(tab.htmlFor.replace('success-story-', ''));
				return;
			}
		}

		if (
			event.target instanceof Element &&
			event.target.closest('.success-stories__control')
		) {
			controlScrollPosition = { x: window.scrollX, y: window.scrollY };

			if (!desktopQuery.matches) {
				event.preventDefault();
				const control = event.target.closest('.success-stories__control');
				const direction = control?.classList.contains('success-stories__control-next')
					? 1
					: -1;

				switchStoryByDirection(direction);
			}
		}
	}, true);

	root.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
		if (handleVideoProgressInput(event.target)) {
			event.preventDefault();
			event.stopPropagation();
		}
	}, true);

	const restoreControlScrollPosition = () => {
		if (!controlScrollPosition) return;

		const { x, y } = controlScrollPosition;
		controlScrollPosition = null;
		window.scrollTo(x, y);
		window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
			window.scrollTo(x, y);
			window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
				window.scrollTo(x, y);
			});
		});
	};

	root.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
		if (event.target instanceof HTMLInputElement && event.target.name === 'success-story') {
			if (desktopQuery.matches) {
				scheduleStoryLayoutSync();
				scheduleDesktopActiveStorySync();
				syncVideos({ resetActive: true });
				return;
			}

			markStorySwitching();
			scheduleStoryLayoutSync();
			restoreControlScrollPosition();

			syncVideos();
		}
	});

	window.addEventListener('scroll', scheduleDesktopActiveStorySync, { passive: true });
	window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleStoryLayoutSync, { passive: true });
	desktopQuery.addEventListener('change', () => {
		setupInfiniteCarouselClones();
		scheduleStoryLayoutSync();
		scheduleDesktopActiveStorySync();
	});
	tabletQuery.addEventListener('change', () => {
		setupInfiniteCarouselClones();
		scheduleStoryLayoutSync();
	});
	mobileQuery.addEventListener('change', () => {
		setupInfiniteCarouselClones();
		scheduleStoryLayoutSync();
	});
	window.addEventListener('load', scheduleStoryLayoutSync, { once: true });

	if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
		document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
			setupSwipeControls();
			setupCustomVideoControls();
			setupVideoInteractionTracking();
			setupInfiniteCarouselClones();
			scheduleStoryLayoutSync();
			scheduleDesktopActiveStorySync();
			syncVideos();
		}, { once: true });
	} else {
		setupSwipeControls();
		setupCustomVideoControls();
		setupVideoInteractionTracking();
		setupInfiniteCarouselClones();
		scheduleStoryLayoutSync();
		scheduleDesktopActiveStorySync();
		syncVideos();
	}
})();

(() => {
	const values = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.stats__value--count-up'));
	if (!values.length) {
		return;
	}

	const fallbackLocale = 'en-US';
	const documentLocale = document.documentElement.lang || navigator.language || fallbackLocale;

	const getLocale = (value) =>
		value.closest('.stats')?.dataset.statsLocale || documentLocale;

	const format = (value, decimals, useGrouping, locale) => {
		const options = {
			maximumFractionDigits: decimals,
			minimumFractionDigits: decimals,
			useGrouping,
		};

		try {
			return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, options).format(value);
		} catch {
			return new Intl.NumberFormat(fallbackLocale, options).format(value);
		}
	};

	if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
		return;
	}

	const animate = (value) => {
		if (value.dataset.statsAnimated === 'true') {
			return;
		}

		value.dataset.statsAnimated = 'true';
		const number = value.querySelector('.stats__number');
		if (!number) {
			return;
		}
		const target = Number(value.dataset.statsTarget || 0);
		const decimals = Number(value.dataset.statsDecimals || 0);
		const originalNumber = value.dataset.statsOriginalNumber || number.textContent;
		const useGrouping = value.dataset.statsUseGrouping === 'true';
		const locale = getLocale(value);
		const duration = 1200;
		const start = performance.now();

		const tick = (now) => {
			const progress = Math.min((now - start) / duration, 1);
			const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
			number.textContent = format(target * eased, decimals, useGrouping, locale);

			if (progress < 1) {
				requestAnimationFrame(tick);
			} else {
				number.textContent = originalNumber;
			}
		};

		number.textContent = format(0, decimals, useGrouping, locale);
		requestAnimationFrame(tick);
	};

	for (const value of values) {
		const number = value.querySelector('.stats__number');
		if (number) {
			number.textContent = format(
				0,
				Number(value.dataset.statsDecimals || 0),
				value.dataset.statsUseGrouping === 'true',

		const control = target.closest('[data-success-story-video-action]');
		if (!(control instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;
		if (control.closest('[data-carousel-clone]')) return true;

		const action = control.dataset.successStoryVideoAction;
		const storyId = control.dataset.successStoryVideoTarget;
		const modalVideo = getModalVideo();
		const isModalControl = Boolean(control.closest('.success-stories__video-modal'));
		const video = isModalControl ? modalVideo : getStoryVideoById(storyId);

		if (!(video instanceof HTMLVideoElement)) return true;
		if (
			isModalControl &&
			action !== 'close-fullscreen' &&
			video.dataset.successStoryAccount
		) {
			trackStoryButtonClick('video_' + video.dataset.successStoryAccount);
		}

		if (action === 'toggle-play') {
			if (video.paused) {
				void video.play().catch(() => undefined);
			} else {
				video.pause();
			}
			syncVideoControls(video);
			return true;
		}

		if (action === 'toggle-muted') {
			video.muted = !video.muted;
			syncVideoControls(video);
			return true;
		}

		if (action === 'open-fullscreen') {
			openFullscreenPlayer(video);
			return true;
		}

		if (action === 'close-fullscreen') {
			closeFullscreenPlayer();
			return true;
		}

		return true;
	};

	const handleVideoProgressInput = (target) => {
		if (!(target instanceof HTMLInputElement)) return false;
		if (target.dataset.successStoryVideoAction !== 'seek') return false;
		if (target.closest('[data-carousel-clone]')) return true;

		const storyId = target.dataset.successStoryVideoTarget;
		const modalVideo = getModalVideo();
		const isModalControl = Boolean(target.closest('.success-stories__video-modal'));
		const video = isModalControl ? modalVideo : getStoryVideoById(storyId);

		if (!(video instanceof HTMLVideoElement) || !video.duration) return true;
		if (isModalControl && video.dataset.successStoryAccount) {
			trackStoryButtonClick('video_' + video.dataset.successStoryAccount);
		}

		video.currentTime = (Number(target.value) / 100) * video.duration;
		syncVideoControls(video);
		return true;
	};

	const setupCustomVideoControls = () => {
		getStoryVideos().forEach((video) => {
			video.removeAttribute('controls');
			video.addEventListener('play', () => syncVideoControls(video));
			video.addEventListener('pause', () => syncVideoControls(video));
			video.addEventListener('timeupdate', () => syncVideoControls(video));
			video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => syncVideoControls(video));
			video.addEventListener('volumechange', () => syncVideoControls(video));
		});

		const modal = getModal();
		const modalVideo = getModalVideo();

		if (modal instanceof HTMLElement && modalVideo) {
			modalVideo.removeAttribute('controls');
			modalVideo.addEventListener('play', () => syncVideoControls(modalVideo));
			modalVideo.addEventListener('pause', () => syncVideoControls(modalVideo));
			modalVideo.addEventListener('timeupdate', () => syncVideoControls(modalVideo));
			modalVideo.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => syncVideoControls(modalVideo));
			modalVideo.addEventListener('volumechange', () => syncVideoControls(modalVideo));
			modal.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
				if (event.target === modal) {
					closeFullscreenPlayer();
				}
			});
			modal.addEventListener('wheel', (event) => {
				event.preventDefault();
			}, { passive: false });
			modal.addEventListener('touchmove', (event) => {
				event.preventDefault();
			}, { passive: false });
		}

		document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
			if (event.key === 'Escape' && fullscreenStoryId) {
				closeFullscreenPlayer();
			}
		});

		window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => closeFullscreenPlayer({ resumeActive: false }));
		startVideoProgressSync();
		syncAllVideoControls();
	};

	const setupVideoInteractionTracking = () => {
		const videos = getStoryVideos();
		const lastTrackedAt = new WeakMap();
		let activeVideo = null;
		let activePointerId = null;
		let startX = 0;
		let startY = 0;

		const getVideoFromPoint = (clientX, clientY) => {
			return videos.find((video) => {
				const rect = video.getBoundingClientRect();

				return (
					clientX >= rect.left &&
					clientX <= rect.right &&
					clientY >= rect.top &&
					clientY <= rect.bottom
				);
			});
		};

		const trackVideo = (video, { requireUserActivation = false } = {}) => {
			if (!(video instanceof HTMLVideoElement)) return;

			const now = window.performance.now();
			const lastTracked = lastTrackedAt.get(video) || 0;

			if (now - lastTracked < 1000) return;
			if (isProgrammaticVideo(video)) return;
			if (requireUserActivation && !window.navigator.userActivation?.isActive) {
				return;
			}
			if (!video.dataset.successStoryAccount) return;

			lastTrackedAt.set(video, now);
			trackStoryButtonClick('video_' + video.dataset.successStoryAccount);
		};

		const beginVideoPointer = (clientX, clientY, pointerId = null) => {
			const video = getVideoFromPoint(clientX, clientY);

			activeVideo = video || null;
			activePointerId = pointerId;
			startX = clientX;
			startY = clientY;
		};

		const endVideoPointer = (clientX, clientY, pointerId = null) => {
			if (activePointerId !== null && pointerId !== activePointerId) return;
			if (!(activeVideo instanceof HTMLVideoElement)) return;

			const endVideo = getVideoFromPoint(clientX, clientY);
			const movedDistance = Math.hypot(clientX - startX, clientY - startY);
			const video = activeVideo;
			activeVideo = null;
			activePointerId = null;

			if (video === endVideo && movedDistance <= 16) {
				trackVideo(video);
			}
		};

		document.addEventListener('pointerdown', (event) => {
			beginVideoPointer(event.clientX, event.clientY, event.pointerId);
		}, true);
		document.addEventListener('pointerup', (event) => {
			endVideoPointer(event.clientX, event.clientY, event.pointerId);
		}, true);
		document.addEventListener('pointercancel', () => {
			activeVideo = null;
			activePointerId = null;
		}, true);
			document.addEventListener('touchstart', (event) => {
				const touch = event.touches?.[0];
				if (!touch) return;

				beginVideoPointer(touch.clientX, touch.clientY, touch.identifier);
			}, true);
			document.addEventListener('touchend', (event) => {
				const touch = event.changedTouches?.[0];
				if (!touch) return;

				endVideoPointer(touch.clientX, touch.clientY, touch.identifier);
			}, true);

			videos.forEach((video) => {
				const trackControlInteraction = () => {
					trackVideo(video, { requireUserActivation: true });
				};
				let isFullscreenVideo = false;

				video.addEventListener('play', trackControlInteraction);
				video.addEventListener('pause', trackControlInteraction);
				video.addEventListener('seeking', trackControlInteraction);
				video.addEventListener('volumechange', trackControlInteraction);
				video.addEventListener('webkitbeginfullscreen', trackControlInteraction);
				video.addEventListener('webkitendfullscreen', trackControlInteraction);

				document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', () => {
					if (document.fullscreenElement === video) {
						isFullscreenVideo = true;
						trackControlInteraction();
						return;
					}

					if (isFullscreenVideo) {
						isFullscreenVideo = false;
						trackControlInteraction();
					}
				});
			});
		};

	root.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
		if (event.target instanceof Element) {
			if (handleVideoControlAction(event.target)) {
				event.preventDefault();
				event.stopPropagation();
				return;
			}

			const tab = event.target.closest('.success-stories__tab');

			if (desktopQuery.matches && tab instanceof HTMLLabelElement) {
				event.preventDefault();
				scrollToStory(tab.htmlFor.replace('success-story-', ''));
				return;
			}
		}

		if (
			event.target instanceof Element &&
			event.target.closest('.success-stories__control')
		) {
			controlScrollPosition = { x: window.scrollX, y: window.scrollY };

			if (!desktopQuery.matches) {
				event.preventDefault();
				const control = event.target.closest('.success-stories__control');
				const direction = control?.classList.contains('success-stories__control-next')
					? 1
					: -1;

				switchStoryByDirection(direction);
			}
		}
	}, true);

	root.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
		if (handleVideoProgressInput(event.target)) {
			event.preventDefault();
			event.stopPropagation();
		}
	}, true);

	const restoreControlScrollPosition = () => {
		if (!controlScrollPosition) return;

		const { x, y } = controlScrollPosition;
		controlScrollPosition = null;
		window.scrollTo(x, y);
		window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
			window.scrollTo(x, y);
			window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
				window.scrollTo(x, y);
			});
		});
	};

	root.addEventListener('change', (event) => {
		if (event.target instanceof HTMLInputElement && event.target.name === 'success-story') {
			if (desktopQuery.matches) {
				scheduleStoryLayoutSync();
				scheduleDesktopActiveStorySync();
				syncVideos({ resetActive: true });
				return;
			}

			markStorySwitching();
			scheduleStoryLayoutSync();
			restoreControlScrollPosition();

			syncVideos();
		}
	});

	window.addEventListener('scroll', scheduleDesktopActiveStorySync, { passive: true });
	window.addEventListener('resize', scheduleStoryLayoutSync, { passive: true });
	desktopQuery.addEventListener('change', () => {
		setupInfiniteCarouselClones();
		scheduleStoryLayoutSync();
		scheduleDesktopActiveStorySync();
	});
	tabletQuery.addEventListener('change', () => {
		setupInfiniteCarouselClones();
		scheduleStoryLayoutSync();
	});
	mobileQuery.addEventListener('change', () => {
		setupInfiniteCarouselClones();
		scheduleStoryLayoutSync();
	});
	window.addEventListener('load', scheduleStoryLayoutSync, { once: true });

	if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
		document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
			setupSwipeControls();
			setupCustomVideoControls();
			setupVideoInteractionTracking();
			setupInfiniteCarouselClones();
			scheduleStoryLayoutSync();
			scheduleDesktopActiveStorySync();
			syncVideos();
		}, { once: true });
	} else {
		setupSwipeControls();
		setupCustomVideoControls();
		setupVideoInteractionTracking();
		setupInfiniteCarouselClones();
		scheduleStoryLayoutSync();
		scheduleDesktopActiveStorySync();
		syncVideos();
	}
})();
</script></section><section class="transactions" data-tea-module-show="ScrollerConversion"><div><div class="transactions__header"><h2>Turn scrollers into shoppers</h2></div><div Performance may differ in other regions.</p><script nonce="1e7f7ee7425a15ccfabb08709896d5c7-argus">
(() => {
	const values = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.stats__value--count-up'));
	if (!values.length) {
		return;
	}

	const fallbackLocale = 'en-US';
	const documentLocale = document.documentElement.lang || navigator.language || fallbackLocale;

	const getLocale = (value) =>
		value.closest('.stats')?.dataset.statsLocale || documentLocale;

	const format = (value, decimals, useGrouping, locale) => {
		const options = {
			maximumFractionDigits: decimals,
			minimumFractionDigits: decimals,
			useGrouping,
		};

		try {
			return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, options).format(value);
		} catch {
			return new Intl.NumberFormat(fallbackLocale, options).format(value);
		}
	};

	if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
		return;
	}

	const animate = (value) => {
		if (value.dataset.statsAnimated === 'true') {
			return;
		}

		value.dataset.statsAnimated = 'true';
		const number = value.querySelector('.stats__number');
		if (!number) {
			return;
		}
		const target = Number(value.dataset.statsTarget || 0);
		const decimals = Number(value.dataset.statsDecimals || 0);
		const originalNumber = value.dataset.statsOriginalNumber || number.textContent;
		const useGrouping = value.dataset.statsUseGrouping === 'true';
		const locale = getLocale(value);
		const duration = 1200;
		const start = performance.now();

		const tick = (now) => {
			const progress = Math.min((now - start) / duration, 1);
			const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
			number.textContent = format(target * eased, decimals, useGrouping, locale);

			if (progress < 1) {
				requestAnimationFrame(tick);
			} else {
				number.textContent = originalNumber;
			}
		};

		number.textContent = format(0, decimals, useGrouping, locale);
		requestAnimationFrame(tick);
	};

	for (const value of values) {
		const number = value.querySelector('.stats__number');
		if (number) {
			number.textContent = format(
				0,
				Number(value.dataset.statsDecimals || 0),
				value.dataset.statsUseGrouping === 'true',
				getLocale(value),
			);
		}
	}

	if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
		values.forEach(animate);
		return;
	}

	const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
		for (const entry of entries) {
			if (entry.isIntersecting) {
				animate(entry.target);
				observer.unobserve(entry.target);
			}
		}
	}, { threshold: 0.35 });

	values.forEach((value) => observer.observe(value));
})();
</script></section><section class="faq" data-tea-module-show="FAQs"><div><h2>FAQs</h2><div class="faq__list"><details class="faq__item" data-tea-module-name="FAQs" data-tea-click-for="tts_portal_faq_question_1_US"><summary><span>Who can sell on TikTok Shop?</span><i aria-hidden="true"></i></summary><div class="faq__answer"><p>Businesses, brands, and individual sellers can apply.     const sourceParamAllowlist = [
      'channel',
      'register_referrer',
      'utm_source',
      'utm_medium',
      'utm_campaign',
      'utm_term',
      'utm_content',
      'track_code',
      'gclid',
      'qhclickid',
      'ad_platform_id',
      'taskid',
    ];
    const hasOwn = (object, key) =>
      Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(object, key);
    const portalNavigationChannels = new Set([
      'portal_v4',
      'portal_header_v4',
      'global_portal_v4',
    ]);

        if (registerChannel) {
          sourceParams.channel = registerChannel;
        }
      }

      if (!currentSearch.has('register_referrer') && document.referrer) {
        sourceParams.register_referrer = document.referrer;
      }

      return sourceParams;
    };

    const isPortalV4PageUrl = (url) =>
      url.hostname === 'seller.tiktok.com' &&
      (url.searchParams.get('from') === 'portal_v4' ||
        portalNavigationChannels.has(url.searchParams.get('channel')));

    const isSellerAccountUrl = (url) => {
      const isSellerHost =
        url.hostname.startsWith('seller-') &&
        (url.hostname.endsWith('.tiktok.com') ||
          url.hostname.endsWith('.tokopedia.com'));
      const isAccountPath = /^\/account\/(?:login|register)(?:\/|$)/.test(
        url.pathname,
      );

      return isSellerHost && isAccountPath;
    };

    const getTrackedTargetUrl = (target, sourceParams) => {
      const anchor = target?.closest?.('a[href]');
      const href = anchor?.getAttribute('href');

      if (!anchor || !href) return null;

      const targetUrl = new URL(href, window.location.href);
      if (!isPortalV4PageUrl(targetUrl) && !isSellerAccountUrl(targetUrl)) {
        return targetUrl;
      }

        if (!targetUrl.searchParams.has(key) && hasOwn(sourceParams, key)) {
          targetUrl.searchParams.set(key, sourceParams[key]);

    const trackButtonClick = (moduleName, clickFor, target) => {
      if (!moduleName || !clickFor) return;

      const sourceParams = getCurrentSourceParams();
      const targetUrl = getTrackedTargetUrl(target, sourceParams);

      const params = {
        module_name: moduleName,
        click_for: clickFor,
        ...(target?.dataset.teaEntrance
          ? { entrance: target.dataset.teaEntrance }
          : {}),
        ...commonTeaParams,
        ...sourceParams,
        url: targetUrl?.toString() ?? '',
      };

      if (targetUrl) {
        for (const key of sourceParamAllowlist) {
          if (!targetUrl.searchParams.has(key)) continue;

          const value = targetUrl.searchParams.get(key);
          if (value) {
            params[key] = value;
          } else {
            delete params[key];
          }
        }

    };

      const target = event.target instanceof Element
        ? event.target.closest('[data-tea-module-name][data-tea-click-for]')
        : null;

      if (!target) return;

      trackButtonClick(target.dataset.teaModuleName, target.dataset.teaClickFor, target);
    });

    document.addEventListener('mock-click', (event) => {

    });

    // -----------module_show---------
    const setupModuleShowTracking = () => {
      if (!('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
        return;
      }

        for (const entry of entries) {

              region_code: "US",
              module_name: moduleName,
              EVENT_ORIGIN_FEATURE: 'TEMAI',
              extra: 'v4_flag_20260616'
            });

        }
